name: glslang
description: Khronos-reference front end for GLSL/ESSL, partial front end for HLSL, and a SPIR-V generator.
build: cd glslang-16.2.0 && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D ALLOW_EXTERNAL_SPIRV_TOOLS=ON -D BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -D GLSLANG_TESTS=OFF -G Ninja .. && ninja $MAKEOPTS
